name: MockObject
summary: Carries the calls it expects to receive and fails when it does not receive them, so that a specification of the interaction is verified by the double itself.

roles.name: MockObject
roles.summary: A double that is told beforehand what it should be asked, and that judges. That is what separates it from a spy: the expectation is set before the exercise and checked by the double, so a test using one can pass its assertions and still fail on a call nobody wrote down.
